body:
I can confirm the bug in versions 4.6.3 stable, 4.7.2 stable and 4.8 dev6 after trying out the MRP.
Godot v4.8.dev6 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor (1920x1080 @ 59.98 Hz) - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8266) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8300H CPU @ 2.30GHz (8 threads) - 11.85 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

Turns out: This bug does not affect only CodeEdit but TextEdit as well (CodeEdit inherits TextEdit)
Also, `EditorSyntaxHighlighter` causes a crash after running the project while it is set to the property `syntax_highlighter` (just like the `GDScriptSyntaxHighlighter` which inherits the EditorSyntaxHighlighter btw)
It currently seems like intentional design to not have the EditorSyntaxHighlighter itself and resources inheriting from it to no be used in run time builds or exports overall. As discussed here: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12470

This simple script for testing this issue led to no crash but two errors reported in the output:
```
extends TextEdit

func _ready() -> void:

	var highlighter = EditorSyntaxHighlighter.new()
	self.syntax_highlighter = highlighter
```


Errors:
```
E 0:00:01:162   bug.gd:5 @ _ready(): Class 'EditorSyntaxHighlighter' can only be instantiated by editor.
  <C++ Source>  core/object/class_db.cpp:592 @ _instantiate_internal()
  <Stack Trace> bug.gd:5 @ _ready()
E 0:00:01:162   bug.gd:5 @ _ready(): Class type: 'EditorSyntaxHighlighter' is not instantiable.
  <C++ Error>   Parameter "o" is null.
  <C++ Source>  modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp:97 @ _new()
  <Stack Trace> bug.gd:5 @ _ready()
```

Same output with GDScriptSyntaxHighlighter replacing EditorSyntaxHighlighter.
